Ironwood Quirk.name: Ironwood Quirk
Ironwood Quirk.description:
🌳 Wood grows from your skin. Flex and the grain locks tight, turning a thin sheet of bark into armor that rings like a steel drum.

🧬 A Fusion Quirk of Plant and Hardening: each side at about half a single Quirk's reach, plus moves only the fusion can do.
🌱 At the start you can shield one forearm with bark or hook a branch around something five meters away.
📈 With training: root anchors, a braced spear, petrified thorns, and a living fortress that opens to let your team through.
⚠️ Only wood still growing from you can harden. A rigid branch stops growing until you soften it. Roots need purchase, and fire can char the grain.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Time Limit. If chosen, pale growth rings tell you when your shell is about to soften.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Kamui Woods (Arbor) and Eijiro Kirishima (Hardening).

📈 Grants: Endurance +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Output +10, Blocking +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Knockbark, Crookwood Reach
Ironwood Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: Body-grown shoots reach five meters at first. One patch of bark can harden at a time initially. More plates and longer branches need training. Limits: Hard wood cannot bend or grow. Cut growth loses its hardness. Roots need cracks or soil. Bark burns and plate seams give. Hardened wood cannot grow: to extend or reshape it the user softens it first (a beat), then hardens it again. Quirk Strain: light: Knockbark, Crookwood Reach; moderate: Doorjamb Roots, Rafter Cradle, Knothole Guard; heavy: Pike Ring, Orchard Jack, Petrified Brake, Forked Passage, Heartwood Reversal; severe: Keep of Rings. Fusion: Plant and Hardening at about half solo reach and coverage. Only attached growth makes ringing bark shields, petrified thorn brakes, and a gated living fortress. Type: Transformation. Law: Roots through a foundation make the grower liable for repairs. Look: Warm russet wood pales to iron-gray along the grain.
